decisions.reason: As a flagship organic sliced salami line with several variants, it closely matches the firm's stated organic expansion and is therefore very likely to stay in the range.
The premium salami sharing line fits the firm's established charcuterie strengths and supports assortment breadth, though it is somewhat less strategic than the core organic push.
This new organic Fleischwurst extends a familiar core category and strengthens the firm's growing Bio range, so it is more likely to be retained than discontinued.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line adds convenient lighter options in several variants and aligns well with the firm's organic and format-expansion direction.

The organic herb-coated salami is a plausible fit with the firm's salami expertise and Bio strategy, but as a more flavor-specific variant it carries a somewhat higher pruning risk than the broader organic lines.
